name: Oberzent (Germany)
description: Horizontal stripes of red, white, red, white and red with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the city arms of Oberzent (quartered red and white with a wheel, a cross and a bear).
history: The city flag was approved together with the arms as part of the boundary-change agreement that formed Oberzent in 2018.

features.role: Oberzent arms — quartered with wheel, cross and bear
